title: Christmas Lights Tour - The 11th Edition
seo_title: Christmas Lights Bike Tour, 11th Edition – Springfield, MO
description: This is a free group bike ride around Springfield on a 10-12 mile route to look at Christmas decorations, with Christmas music playing from a speaker. Riders can decorate themselves and their bikes, and headlights and taillights are required; the ride is in the dark and likely cold, so dress accordingly. It takes place Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM, starting at Jarrett Middle School, 906 W Portland St, Springfield, MO.
